business_summary: Nippon Hotel & Residential Investment Corporation is a real estate investment trust (with capital investment of 200 million yen and 2,000 units issued). Under the Act on Investment Trusts and Investment Corporations (Act No. 198 of 1951, as amended) (the Investment Trust Act), and completed its registration with the Kanto Local Finance Bureau on May 13, 2016 (Registration Number: Kanto Local Finance Bureau Director-General No. 119). Subsequently, the Investment Corporation issued new investment units (174,200 units) through a public offering with a payment deadline of August 30, 2016, and was listed on the Real Estate Investment Trust Securities Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange, Inc. on August 31, 2016 (Stock Code: 3472). In the 15th fiscal period (ending November 2023), we acquired four properties, including rental housing, etc. (Note 1) (with a total acquisition price (Note 2) of 4,898 million yen), and in the 18th fiscal period (ending May 2025), we issued new investment units (75,676 units in total) through a public offering with payment due on December 2, 2024, and through a third-party allotment with payment due on December 30, 2024, and acquired a total of eight properties, including two hotels, etc. (Note 3) and six rental housing, etc. (with a total acquisition price of 13,108 million yen). During the fiscal period under review, the Investment Corporation transferred two properties, including hotels (total transfer price: 1,897 million yen), and acquired one property, including hotels, and one property, including rental housing, (total acquisition price: 2,020 million yen). As of the end of the fiscal period under review, the Investment Corporation held a total of 23 properties under management (total acquisition price: 49,251 million yen), and the total number of investment units issued and outstanding as of the end of the fiscal period under review was 311,023. Nippon Hotel & Residential Investment Corporation was established on March 29, 2016.
business_summary_ko: Nippon Hotel & Residential Investment Corporation은 부동산 투자 신탁(자본금 2억엔, 발행 2,000호)입니다. 투자신탁 및 투자회사에 관한 법률(1951년 법률 제198호, 개정)(투자신탁법)에 따라 2016년 5월 13일에 간토재무국에 등록을 완료했습니다(등록번호: 간토재무관장 제119호). 이후 투자공사는 납입기한을 2016년 8월 30일로 하여 공모를 통해 신규 투자단위(174,200호)를 발행하였고, 2016년 8월 31일 도쿄증권거래소 부동산투자신탁증권시장(주식코드: 3472)에 상장되었습니다. 제15기(2023년 11월 종료)에 임대주택 등 4개 부동산을 취득(주1)(총취득가격(주2) 4,898백만엔)하고, 제18회기(2025년 5월 종료)에는 2024년 12월 2일 납부기한 공모와 제3자를 통해 신규 투자 유닛(총 75,676호)을 발행했습니다. 2024년 12월 30일 지급 예정이며 총 8개 부동산을 취득하였습니다.
